description.value: The Great Bear Pub is a progressive neighborhood pub on Kingsway in Burnaby, offering a modern pub menu with live entertainment six nights a week. It features a games room with Darts Live and a pool table that can be booked for private events, and it hosts regular community programming including karaoke, trivia, and open jam nights. Online ordering for pickup and takeout is available.
